verdict.rationale: The public Jobs API docs cover every step an agent holding a key needs. It can test the key (GET /v2/jobs/auth), create a job from a URL or a direct upload, and poll the read endpoint for status and results, or get completion via webhooks or SSE. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages, openapi.json) are probed live, so no human step is required once the key exists. Missing for 10: the exact auth header scheme is not quoted, and there is no hands-on or independent end-to-end run from submission to finished transcript.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent holding an API key can take a recording from submission to finished transcript (auth, job creation, result retrieval) from the public docs alone, with no human step in between

citations.quote: GET /v2/jobs/auth endpoint to test the authentication
